title: RCPC representation — capability vocabulary
description: The capability vocabulary's metaschema. The instances live in `capabilities.json`, which validates against `#/$defs/capabilities_payload`; this file declares no instances. The Planning Service's domain content, the Orchestration Service's dispatch logic, and the robot resources reference those entries by identifier; none encodes a second copy. Adding a capability type is an additive minor; removing one, or changing what an identifier means, is a major. See representation.md section 6.

capability_type_id.title: Capability-type identifier
capability_type_id.description: References one entry of the capability vocabulary by identifier. The vocabulary is enumerated once, in `capability.schema.json`.

id.description: The identifier every other component references. Stable for the life of the major version.

capabilities.title: An array of capability references
capabilities.description: How an action states what it needs, and how a robot resource states what it offers. Matched by identifier; membership enforced by validate.py, not this schema.

capabilities_payload.title: query-representation, scope = capabilities
capabilities_payload.description: The `capabilities` query scope: the whole vocabulary, as served.

description.description: Optional annotation. Present on `capabilities.json`; a served payload omits it.
